name: Workflow connectors (block catalogue)
description: SPIKE: a catalogue of workflow blocks (HTTP request, text helpers, Google Sheets, Jira, lyam user provisioning) backed by real Activepieces pieces (MIT) through a local adapter, plus two start triggers (a public HTTP webhook and a Google-Sheet-style row watcher). External effects are honest: a block without its credentials, or Jira with dryRun on, only logs what it WOULD do; the Google demo source is a built-in simulated sheet until a service account is typed in the console. Secrets are console-typed secret settings, never code, never seed.

settings.label: HTTP block: extra allowed hosts
settings.help: Comma-separated host names the HTTP request block may call IN ADDITION to public internet hosts. Loopback and private ranges always require an entry here (SSRF guard).

settings.label: Jira instance URL
settings.help: e.g. https://example.atlassian.net (the demo uses the sandbox site).

settings.label: Jira API token
settings.help: Typed here in the console, masked afterwards, never in code, seed or chat.

settings.label: Google service account JSON key
settings.help: The whole JSON key of a service account the spreadsheet is shared with. Without it, the Google blocks only serve the built-in DEMO sheet (simulated).

settings.label: Google user to impersonate (optional)
settings.help: Only for domain-wide delegation; leave empty otherwise.
